data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate recorded a net release of prior year gross reserves of $74.5m in 2020 (a c.2.8% release of opening gross claims outstanding of $2,645.3m), driven by favourable claims development and settlements predominantly in the Marine, Energy and Treaty divisions. Offsetting movements in 2020 included significant reserve strengthening for Covid-19 exposures and increased reserves in Casualty, Political Risk & Credit, Property and Treaty reinsurance classes; separately, 2020 experienced multiple natural catastrophe events (notably Hurricanes Laura, Zeta, Sally and Delta and the Midwest Derecho) which were of relatively low severity with limited excess of loss reinsurance recoveries. The prior year release is explicitly stated in the accounts and the gross claims development table is provided in the notes.
raw_causal_phrases: During 2020 the Syndicate released $74.5m of technical reserves in respect of prior periods (2019: $38.3m), arising predominantly from the Marine, Energy and Treaty divisions (2018: primarily from the Marine, Energy and Property Divisions). These releases were due to favourable claims development on prior year losses during 2020.
The underwriting result did benefit from more favourable prior year development than 2019 with significant releases on a number of large risk losses following favourable settlements.

The unprecedented global Covid-19 pandemic, along with National Lockdowns and the ensuing global economic slump, has resulted in significant reserves being established in our Casualty, Political Risk and Credit, Property and Treaty Reinsurance classes.

data.data_quality_notes: Prior year development figure taken from Note 4 narrative: 'During 2020 the Syndicate released $74.5m...'. The note is explicit but does not allocate the release by line of business in monetary terms (LOB allocation is descriptive). The accounts include gross and net claims development triangles (Note 20) which were used to extract the gross triangle. There were Part VII and RITC transactions described (Part VII transfer of policies to Lloyd's Brussels effective 30 Dec 2020; RITC accepted on 1 Jan 2021 for Syndicate 6130) which may distort comparisons beyond the reporting date; the RITC for Syndicate 6130 is effective 1 Jan 2021 and therefore not reflected as a prior-year movement in the 2020 PYD figure. All amounts are reported in the syndicate functional currency (USD) as presented in the accounts.
